parameters.content:
# OrbitPage Release Guardian

Monitors saved OrbitPage revisions, verifies the public page, emails an optional success report, and offers a human-approved rollback to the last revision previously verified by this workflow. **No unattended rollback occurs.**

### Quick setup
1. Install `n8n-nodes-orbitpage@0.3.2` or newer. Select the same OrbitPage credential on every OrbitPage node and Gmail OAuth2 on every Gmail node.
2. Required token scopes: `workspace:read`, `publication:read`, `publication:write`, `backup:read`, `backup:write`.
3. In **Configuration**, replace the email address. Keep `SEND_SUCCESS_EMAIL=YES` for the first test and `ENABLE_PUBLISH=NO` for normal dashboard editing.
4. Run **When Manually Started** once. Then activate the workflow and save an OrbitPage change. The polling trigger checks saved server revisions once per minute; it cannot see unsaved browser fields.

---
**Created by Paolo Ronco, also the creator of OrbitPage.**  
OrbitPage support: [contact@orbitpage.com](mailto:contact@orbitpage.com)  
Workflow support: [contact@orbitpage.com](mailto:contact@orbitpage.com) or [info@paoloronco.it](mailto:info@paoloronco.it)

## 1 · Trigger, configuration, and safe reads

- **Manual trigger:** validates the current release during setup.
- **OrbitPage trigger:** polls the saved workspace revision every minute. It is not a webhook or event log.
- **Configuration:** sets the notification address, success-email preference, and optional private-draft approval mode.
- **Read nodes:** fetch workspace, full draft, and publication status with its ETag.

This module is read-only. Dashboard saves normally publish automatically before the next poll.

## 3 · Private draft approval — optional

Used only when an eligible API or ChatGPT write intentionally leaves `draftRevision` ahead of `publishedRevision` and `ENABLE_PUBLISH=YES`.

The email link resumes the workflow and publishes the exact reviewed ETag. Any edit made while approval is pending causes OrbitPage to reject the stale state instead of publishing newer, unreviewed work. Normal dashboard saves do not use this branch.

## 4 · Published-release routing

A new already-published dashboard revision proceeds to the public-page check. A revision already verified by this workflow ends as a safe duplicate.

Private drafts remain unchanged when approval mode is disabled or validation reports findings. A blocked-draft email is sent only when `ENABLE_PUBLISH=YES`; no public state is changed in this module.

## 5 · Verify the public release

Requests the exact public URL and checks HTTP status, response size, and obvious maintenance content. Transport failures can retry up to three times; returned HTTP error responses are evaluated immediately.

A successful production execution stores only the bounded snapshot and verified revision in workflow static data. `SEND_SUCCESS_EMAIL=YES` sends the release summary. A failed check moves to assisted rollback.

## 6 · Human-approved rollback

If the live check fails, the workflow uses the last revision it previously verified—not the failing release. It confirms that version still exists, captures the current workspace ETag, and emails a rollback approval link.

Only an explicit click restores and republishes the historical version. A concurrent edit invalidates the ETag and fails safely. The restored page is checked again. On the first baseline, no earlier verified revision exists, so the workflow alerts and stops without restoring anything.
